verses.en: And when the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon concerning the name of the LORD, she came to prove him with hard questions.
verses.pt: Tendo a rainha de Sabá ouvido da fama de Salomão, no que concerne ao nome do Senhor, veio prová-lo por enigmas.
verses.en_web: When the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon concerning Yahweh’s name, she came to test him with hard questions.
verses.en_bbe: Now the queen of Sheba, hearing great things of Solomon, came to put his wisdom to the test with hard questions.

verses.en: And she came to Jerusalem with a very great train, with camels that bare spices, and very much gold, and precious stones: and when she was come to Solomon, she communed with him of all that was in her heart.
verses.pt: E chegou a Jerusalém com uma grande comitiva, com camelos carregados de especiarias, e muitíssimo ouro, e pedras preciosas; e, tendo-se apresentado a Salomão, conversou com ele acerca de tudo o que tinha ne coração.
verses.en_web: She came to Jerusalem with a very great caravan, with camels that bore spices, very much gold, and precious stones; and when she had come to Solomon, she talked with him about all that was in her heart.
verses.en_bbe: And she came to Jerusalem with a very great train, with camels weighted down with spices, and stores of gold and jewels: and when she came to Solomon she had talk with him of everything in her mind.

verses.en: And Solomon told her all her questions: there was not any thing hid from the king, which he told her not.
verses.pt: E Salomão lhe deu resposta a todas as suas perguntas; não houve nada que o rei não lhe soubesse explicar.
verses.en_web: Solomon answered all her questions. There was not anything hidden from the king which he didn’t tell her.
verses.en_bbe: And Solomon gave her answers to all her questions; there was no secret which the king did not make clear to her.

verses.en: And when the queen of Sheba had seen all Solomon’s wisdom, and the house that he had built,
verses.pt: Vendo, pois, a rainha de Sabá toda a sabedoria de Salomão, a casa que edificara,
verses.en_web: When the queen of Sheba had seen all the wisdom of Solomon, the house that he had built,
verses.en_bbe: And when the queen of Sheba had seen all the wisdom of Solomon, and the house which he had made,

verses.en: And the meat of his table, and the sitting of his servants, and the attendance of his ministers, and their apparel, and his cupbearers, and his ascent by which he went up unto the house of the LORD; there was no more spirit in her.
verses.pt: as iguarias da sua mesa, o assentar dos seus oficiais, as funções e os trajes dos seus servos, e os seus copeiros, e os holocaustos que ele oferecia na casa do Senhor, ficou estupefata,
verses.en_web: the food of his table, the sitting of his servants, the attendance of his officials, their clothing, his cup bearers, and his ascent by which he went up to Yahweh’s house; there was no more spirit in her.
verses.en_bbe: And the food at his table, and all his servants seated there, and those who were waiting on him in their places, and their robes, and his wine-servants, and the burned offerings which he made in the house of the Lord, there was no more spirit in her.

verses.en: And she said to the king, It was a true report that I heard in mine own land of thy acts and of thy wisdom.
verses.pt: e disse ao rei: Era verdade o que ouvi na minha terra, acerca des teus feitos e da tua sabedoria.
verses.en_web: She said to the king, “It was a true report that I heard in my own land of your acts, and of your wisdom.
verses.en_bbe: And she said to the king, The account which was given to me in my country of your acts and your wisdom was true.

verses.en: Howbeit I believed not the words, until I came, and mine eyes had seen it: and, behold, the half was not told me: thy wisdom and prosperity exceedeth the fame which I heard.
verses.pt: Contudo eu não o acreditava, até que vim e os meus olhos o viram. Eis que não me disseram metade; sobrepujaste em sabedoria e bens a fama que ouvi.
verses.en_web: However I didn’t believe the words until I came and my eyes had seen it. Behold, not even half was told me! Your wisdom and prosperity exceed the fame which I heard.
verses.en_bbe: But I had no faith in what was said about you, till I came and saw for myself; and now I see that it was not half the story; your wisdom and your wealth are much greater than they said.

verses.en: Happy are thy men, happy are these thy servants, which stand continually before thee, and that hear thy wisdom.
verses.pt: Bem-aventurados os teus homens! Bem-aventuradas estes teus servos, que estão sempre diante de ti, que ouvem a tua sabedoria!
verses.en_web: Happy are your men, happy are these your servants, who stand continually before you, who hear your wisdom.
verses.en_bbe: Happy are your wives, happy are these your servants whose place is ever before you, hearing your words of wisdom.

verses.en: Blessed be the LORD thy God, which delighted in thee, to set thee on the throne of Israel: because the LORD loved Israel for ever, therefore made he thee king, to do judgment and justice.
verses.pt: Bendito seja o Senhor teu Deus, que se agradou de ti e te colocou no trono de Israel! Porquanto o Senhor amou Israel para sempre, por isso te estabeleceu rei, para executares juízo e justiça.
verses.en_web: Blessed is Yahweh your God, who delighted in you, to set you on the throne of Israel. Because Yahweh loved Israel forever, therefore he made you king, to do justice and righteousness.”
verses.en_bbe: May the Lord your God be praised, whose pleasure it was to put you on the seat of the kingdom of Israel; because the Lord's love for Israel is eternal, he has made you king, to be their judge in righteousness.

verses.en: And she gave the king an hundred and twenty talents of gold, and of spices very great store, and precious stones: there came no more such abundance of spices as these which the queen of Sheba gave to king Solomon.
verses.pt: E deu ela ao rei cento e vinte talentos de ouro, especiarias em grande quantidade e pedras preciosas; nunca mais apareceu tamanha abundância de especiarias como a que a rainha de Sabá deu ao rei Salomão.
verses.en_web: She gave the king one hundred twenty talents of gold, and a very great quantity of spices, and precious stones. Never again was there such an abundance of spices as these which the queen of Sheba gave to king Solomon.
verses.en_bbe: And she gave the king a hundred and twenty talents of gold, and a great store of spices and jewels: never again was such a wealth of spices seen as that which the queen of Sheba gave King Solomon.

verses.en: And the navy also of Hiram, that brought gold from Ophir, brought in from Ophir great plenty of almug trees, and precious stones.
verses.pt: Também a frota de Hirão, que de Ofir trazia ouro, trouxe dali madeira de almugue em quantidade, e pedras preciosas.
verses.en_web: The fleet of Hiram that brought gold from Ophir, also brought in from Ophir great quantities of almug trees and precious stones.
verses.en_bbe: And the sea-force of Hiram, in addition to gold from Ophir, came back with much sandal-wood and jewels.

verses.en: And the king made of the almug trees pillars for the house of the LORD, and for the king’s house, harps also and psalteries for singers: there came no such almug trees, nor were seen unto this day.
verses.pt: Desta madeira de almugue fez e rei balaústres para a casa do Senhor, e para a casa de rei, como também harpas e alaúdes para os cantores; não se trouxe nem se viu mais tal madeira de almugue, até o dia de hoje.
verses.en_web: The king made of the almug trees pillars for Yahweh’s house, and for the king’s house, harps also and stringed instruments for the singers; no such almug trees came or were seen, to this day.
verses.en_bbe: And from the sandal-wood the king made pillars for the house of the Lord, and for the king's house, and instruments of music for the makers of melody: never has such sandal-wood been seen to this day.

verses.en: And king Solomon gave unto the queen of Sheba all her desire, whatsoever she asked, beside that which Solomon gave her of his royal bounty. So she turned and went to her own country, she and her servants.
verses.pt: E o rei salomão deu à rainha de Sabà tudo o que ela desejou, tudo quanto pediu, além de que lhe dera espontaneamente, da sua munificência real. Então voltou e foi para a sua terra, ela e os seus servos.
verses.en_web: King Solomon gave to the queen of Sheba all her desire, whatever she asked, besides that which Solomon gave her of his royal bounty. So she turned and went to her own land, she and her servants.
verses.en_bbe: And King Solomon gave the queen of Sheba all her desire, whatever she made request for, in addition to what he gave her freely from the impulse of his heart. So she went back to her country, she and her servants.

verses.en: Now the weight of gold that came to Solomon in one year was six hundred threescore and six talents of gold.
verses.pt: Ora, o peso do ouro que se trazia a Salomão cada ano era de seiscentos e sessenta e seis talentos de ouro,
verses.en_web: Now the weight of gold that came to Solomon in one year was six hundred sixty-six talents of gold,
verses.en_bbe: Now the weight of gold which came to Solomon in one year was six hundred and sixty-six talents;

verses.en: Beside that he had of the merchantmen, and of the traffick of the spice merchants, and of all the kings of Arabia, and of the governors of the country.
verses.pt: além do que vinha dos vendedores ambulantes, e do tráfico dos negociantes, e de todos as reis da Arábia, e dos governadores do país.
verses.en_web: besides that which the traders brought, and the traffic of the merchants, and of all the kings of the mixed people, and of the governors of the country.
verses.en_bbe: In addition to what came to him from the business of the traders, and from all the kings of the Arabians, and from the rulers of the country.

verses.en: And king Solomon made two hundred targets of beaten gold: six hundred shekels of gold went to one target.
verses.pt: Também o rei Salomão fez duzentos paveses de ouro batido; de seiscentos siclos de ouro mandou fazer cada pavês;
verses.en_web: King Solomon made two hundred bucklers of beaten gold; six hundred shekels of gold went to one buckler.
verses.en_bbe: And Solomon made two hundred body-covers of hammered gold, every one having six hundred shekels of gold in it.

verses.en: And he made three hundred shields of beaten gold; three pound of gold went to one shield: and the king put them in the house of the forest of Lebanon.
verses.pt: do mesmo modo fez também trezentos escudos de ouro batido; de três minas de auro mandou fazer cada escudo. Então e rei os pôs na casa do bosque de Líbano.
verses.en_web: he made three hundred shields of beaten gold; three minas of gold went to one shield; and the king put them in the House of the Forest of Lebanon.
verses.en_bbe: And he made three hundred smaller body-covers of hammered gold, with three pounds of gold in every cover: and the king put them in the house of the Woods of Lebanon.

verses.en: Moreover the king made a great throne of ivory, and overlaid it with the best gold.
verses.pt: Fez mais o rei um grande trono de marfim, e o revestiu de ouro puríssimo.
verses.en_web: Moreover the king made a great throne of ivory, and overlaid it with the finest gold.
verses.en_bbe: Then the king made a great ivory seat, plated with the best gold.

verses.en: The throne had six steps, and the top of the throne was round behind: and there were stays on either side on the place of the seat, and two lions stood beside the stays.
verses.pt: Tinha o trono seis degraus, e o alto do trono era redondo pelo espaldar; de ambos os lados tinha braços junto ao assento, e dois leões em pé junto aos braços.
verses.en_web: There were six steps to the throne, and the top of the throne was round behind; and there were armrests on either side by the place of the seat, and two lions standing beside the armrests.
verses.en_bbe: There were six steps going up to it, and the top of it was round at the back, there were arms on the two sides of the seat, and two lions by the side of the arms;

verses.en: And twelve lions stood there on the one side and on the other upon the six steps: there was not the like made in any kingdom.
verses.pt: E sobre os seis degraus havia doze leões de ambos os lados; outro tal não se fizera em reino algum.
verses.en_web: Twelve lions stood there on the one side and on the other on the six steps. Nothing like it was made in any kingdom.
verses.en_bbe: And twelve lions were placed on the one side and on the other side on the six steps: there was nothing like it in any kingdom.

verses.en: And all king Solomon’s drinking vessels were of gold, and all the vessels of the house of the forest of Lebanon were of pure gold; none were of silver: it was nothing accounted of in the days of Solomon.
verses.pt: Também todos os vasos de beber de rei Salomão eram de ouro, e todos os vasos da casa do bosque do Líbano eram de ouro puro; não havia nenhum de prata, porque nos dias de Salomão a prata não tinha estimação alguma.
verses.en_web: All king Solomon’s drinking vessels were of gold, and all the vessels of the House of the Forest of Lebanon were of pure gold. None were of silver, because it was considered of little value in the days of Solomon.
verses.en_bbe: And all King Solomon's drinking-vessels were of gold, and all the vessels of the house of the Woods of Lebanon were of the best gold; not one was of silver, for no one gave a thought to silver in the days of King Solomon.

verses.en: For the king had at sea a navy of Tharshish with the navy of Hiram: once in three years came the navy of Tharshish, bringing gold, and silver, ivory, and apes, and peacocks.
verses.pt: Porque o rei tinha no mar uma frota de Társis, com a de Hirão; de três em três anos a frota de Társis voltava, trazendo ouro e prata, marfim, bugios e pavões.
verses.en_web: For the king had a fleet of Tarshish at sea with Hiram’s fleet. Once every three years the fleet of Tarshish came, bringing gold, silver, ivory, apes, and peacocks.
verses.en_bbe: For the king had Tarshish-ships at sea with the ships of Hiram; once every three years the Tarshish-ships came with gold and silver and ivory and monkeys and peacocks.

verses.en: So king Solomon exceeded all the kings of the earth for riches and for wisdom.
verses.pt: Assim o rei Salomão excedeu a todos os reis da terra, tanto em riquezas como em sabedoria.
verses.en_web: So king Solomon exceeded all the kings of the earth in riches and in wisdom.
verses.en_bbe: And King Solomon was greater than all the kings of the earth in wealth and in wisdom.

verses.en: And all the earth sought to Solomon, to hear his wisdom, which God had put in his heart.
verses.pt: E toda a terra buscava a presença de Salomão para ouvir a sabedoria que Deus lhe tinha posto no coração.
verses.en_web: All the earth sought the presence of Solomon, to hear his wisdom, which God had put in his heart.
verses.en_bbe: And from all over the earth they came to see Solomon and to give ear to his wisdom, which God had put in his heart.

verses.en: And they brought every man his present, vessels of silver, and vessels of gold, and garments, and armour, and spices, horses, and mules, a rate year by year.
verses.pt: Cada um trazia seu presente, vasos de prata, vasos de ouro, vestidos, armaduras, especiarias, cavalos e mulas; isso faziam cada ano.
verses.en_web: Year after year, every man brought his tribute, vessels of silver, vessels of gold, clothing, armor, spices, horses, and mules.
verses.en_bbe: And everyone took with him an offering, vessels of silver and vessels of gold, and robes, and coats of metal, and spices, and horses, and beasts of transport, regularly year by year.

verses.en: And Solomon gathered together chariots and horsemen: and he had a thousand and four hundred chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen, whom he bestowed in the cities for chariots, and with the king at Jerusalem.
verses.pt: Também ajuntou Salomão carros e cavaleiros, de sorte que tinha mil e quatrocentos carros e doze mil cavaleiros, e os distribuiu pelas cidades dos carros, e junto ao rei em Jerusalém.
verses.en_web: Solomon gathered together chariots and horsemen. He had one thousand four hundred chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen, that he kept in the chariot cities and with the king at Jerusalem.
verses.en_bbe: And Solomon got together war-carriages and horsemen; he had one thousand, four hundred carriages and twelve thousand horsemen, whom he kept, some in the carriage-towns and some with the king at Jerusalem.

verses.en: And the king made silver to be in Jerusalem as stones, and cedars made he to be as the sycomore trees that are in the vale, for abundance.
verses.pt: E o rei tornou a prata tão comum em Jerusalém como as pedras, e os cedros tantos em abundância como os sicômoros que há pelas campinas.
verses.en_web: The king made silver as common as stones in Jerusalem, and cedars as common as the sycamore trees that are in the lowland.
verses.en_bbe: And the king made silver as common as stones in Jerusalem and cedars like the sycamore-trees of the lowlands in number.

verses.en: And Solomon had horses brought out of Egypt, and linen yarn: the king’s merchants received the linen yarn at a price.
verses.pt: Os cavalos que Salomão tinha eram trazidos do Egito e de Coa; os mercadores do rei os recebiam de Coa por preço determinado.
verses.en_web: The horses which Solomon had were brought out of Egypt. The king’s merchants received them in droves, each drove at a price.
verses.en_bbe: And Solomon's horses came from Egypt and from Kue; the king's traders got them at a price from Kue.

verses.en: And a chariot came up and went out of Egypt for six hundred shekels of silver, and an horse for an hundred and fifty: and so for all the kings of the Hittites, and for the kings of Syria, did they bring them out by their means.
verses.pt: E subia e saía um carro do Egito por seiscentos siclos de prata, e um cavalo por cento e cinqüenta; e assim, por intermédio desses mercadores, eram exportados para todos os reis dos heteus e para os reis da Síria.
verses.en_web: A chariot came up and went out of Egypt for six hundred shekels of silver, and a horse for one hundred fifty shekels; and so they exported them to all the kings of the Hittites, and to the kings of Syria.
verses.en_bbe: A war-carriage might be got from Egypt for six hundred shekels of silver, and a horse for a hundred and fifty; they got them at the same rate for all the kings of the Hittites and the kings of Aram.
